posts.title: Call Me Traitor, a sapphic fantasy by Everina Maxwell
posts.description: After reading this book, I’m convinced. Everina Maxwell is going on my authors to follow list. Call Me Traitor blends so many distinct themes into one beautiful Sapphic story about rebellion, politics, love, academia, and war through a lens of neurodivergency and trauma.
